description: User-supplied final slide. Original QR JPEG with its alpha mask and native vector social icons are retained without recompression. Text is rebuilt in Inter.
text: Editable title, optional subtitle and copyright; original defaults use @BitPolito and the current-year BitPolito copyright.
without_qrcode: Hide the QR and shift the text/social group left by 371.45 source units to the slide centre.
retained_source: Prepared PDF parts are retained sources; ordinary compilation needs no converter, PDF library or original export.
